name: GPT-Live
description: Talk over the model and watch it listen while it speaks. A live three-lane timeline shows you, GPT-Live, and the backend model it delegates reasoning and tool calls to.

zh.name: GPT-Live
zh.description: 在模型说话时直接插话，看它边说边听。实时三轨时间线展示你、GPT-Live，以及它委派推理和工具调用的后端模型。

name: Decision models
description: Send the same input and typed questions (yes/no, choice, score) to three decision models at once. Compare answers, probabilities, agreement, and latency side by side.

zh.name: 决策模型
zh.description: 把同一段输入和带类型的问题（是/否、选择、评分）同时发给三个决策模型，并排比较答案、概率、一致性和延迟。

name: Image models
description: Send one prompt to four image models on Foundry at the same pixel size. Compare time to image, a checklist score for instruction following, quality (by hand or a blind judge model), and cost per image.

zh.name: 图像模型
zh.tagline: GPT-Image-2.5 Flare 与 Sunburst · MAI-Image-2.6 与 Flash
zh.description: 把同一个提示词以相同像素尺寸发给 Foundry 上的四个图像模型，比较出图耗时、按检查清单评估的指令遵循、图片质量（人工或盲评模型打分）以及单张成本。

name: Web IQ
tagline: Microsoft Web IQ vs Google (SerpApi) · Tavily · Exa · Brave · Perplexity · Parallel
description: Send one query to Microsoft Web IQ and the leading web search APIs for AI, and compare the results side by side: search speed, blind-judged relevance, freshness, content returned, and cost.

zh.name: Web IQ
zh.tagline: Microsoft Web IQ 对比 Google（SerpApi）· Tavily · Exa · Brave · Perplexity · Parallel
zh.description: 把同一个查询发给 Microsoft Web IQ 和主流 AI 搜索 API，并排比较检索结果：检索速度、盲评相关度、新鲜度、返回内容量和成本。
